name: Sprint
steps: Start from a staggered athletic stance with your torso leaned slightly forward, core braced, and arms bent at roughly 90 degrees.
Drive powerfully off the balls of your feet into an explosive forward acceleration, pumping your arms vigorously cheek to hip.
Rise smoothly into tall upright sprinting posture while driving your knees high and pulling your feet sharply underneath your hips.
Maintain strong alternating strides over the target distance or duration, then decelerate smoothly rather than stopping abruptly.
tips: Warm up thoroughly with gradual progressive accelerations before running at top speed.
Keep your face, jaw, and shoulders relaxed so unnecessary tension does not slow your stride.
